title: ZooCube
sources: own RAM search with gbaverify (no RA notes): the HUD score 685 -> 0 (new game) -> 40 -> 0 matched a u32 at 0x030026D0 (only match)

widgets.text:
Score, level; cube rotation
Puzzle game by Acclaim: animal shapes fly in from four sides towards a cube in the middle
Score and level; the game ends when shapes pile too high on a side

Animal pieces fall on the cube's sides
Rotate the cube so a shape lands on the side with the same animal: two matching animals disappear
Animals include lions, elephants, penguins and other zoo animals (each a coloured shape)

Match two same animals to clear
Keep every side low; match quickly when shapes speed up at higher levels
Shapes coming from opposite sides at once: rotate to the side that clears the most

rows: puzzle (fixed starting layouts) and arcade (endless levels)

widgets.text:
Next pieces
Next shapes are shown at the screen edges
Shapes come from all four sides at once at higher levels

Animals
Level and high scores per mode
Puzzle mode has set layouts to solve

Levels
Levels cleared in puzzle mode; high score in arcade
Arcade levels speed up after each set of matches
